messages.充電回数を3以上に保ってS2「振動圧着」のコインを再使用させ、最大4コイン・振動: A Tremor and Charge attacker that maintains at least 3 Charge Count to reuse S2 Vibration Compression's Coins, reaching up to 4 Coins, 12 Tremor application, and Tremor Burst. Alone, she normally alternates S1 for Charge with S2; suitable Tremor and Charge Gifts can let her use S2 repeatedly.
messages.S2「振動圧着」のコイン再使用: Ⅱコインは自分の充電回数が3以上なら、表面が出: **S2 Vibration Compression's Coin reuse**: Coin Ⅱ is reused each time it lands Heads while her Charge Count is 3 or more, up to 2 times. Each reuse adds +2 to the Tremor inflicted (2→4→6), and after 2 reuses it inflicts Tremor and triggers Tremor Burst. The reuse itself does not consume Charge Count (the passive spends it on Tremor Burst). +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 10 Tremor Count.
messages.充電回数の獲得: S1「エンジン始動」は使用時に+2、Ⅰコインの的中時に+4(同: **Gaining Charge Count**: S1 Rev Up adds +2 on use and +4 on Coin Ⅰ hit (Uptie Ⅳ; also inflicts 1 Tremor on Heads Hit). S3 Let’s Rack Up Some Scores adds +6 on use. The Defense skill Preheat adds +2 at Combat Start. Charge loses 1 Count at Turn End.
messages.バトルパッシブ「早上がりのために～」(傲慢×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 振動爆: **Combat passive — Here’s to Getting Off Early~ (4 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On Tremor Burst, spends 3 Charge Count for +40% Stagger Threshold shift from that burst. When Tremor Burst occurs, she gains 1 Haste and 1 Blunt DMG Up next turn.
messages.S3: 3コイン。Ⅱ・Ⅲコインで振動爆発(Ⅱコインは表面的中時に振動2も付与)。: **S3**: 3 Coins. Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ trigger Tremor Burst (Coin Ⅱ also inflicts 2 Tremor on Heads Hit). If the target is staggered, Coin Ⅲ deals additional damage equal to 25% of the damage dealt.
messages.S2の再使用には「充電回数3以上」と「表面」の両方が要る。パッシブが発動している: S2's reuse requires both 3 or more Charge Count and Heads. With the passive active, each Tremor Burst spends 3 Charge Count, so after firing S3 (2 bursts, up to 6 spent) and similar, Count tends to run short. S1 only gains +2 Count if its first Coin misses, so land it as a one-sided attack whenever possible to earn Count and pass it to S2. In regular battles, her Defense skill can also add +2 at Combat Start. S2's Clash Power is lowish (up to 12), so raise her SP early. She suits the Mirror Dungeon, where Tremor and Charge Gifts are easy to gather.
